title: Exhibition and Professional Practices in Contemporary Art
description: Capstone experience of the BFA program. Engages collaborative planning and execution of a professional large-scale group exhibition. Includes presentations by living artists to highlight diverse professional practices.
notes: Includes content from the Living Artists, Living Art Lecture Series with presentations by local, regional, national, and international artists.
Speaker content varies each term based on individual research and practice.

Practical skills include curation, documentation, catalogue design and funding, event planning and promotion, publicity, art handling, exhibition preparation, and professional installation and lighting of artworks.
*Indicates 1.5-hour tutorials involving artist lectures scheduled periodically throughout the term. Schedule of talk dates provided at the start of course.
